answer: Output-similarity pooling: each epoch, peers embed every submitted answer and any group that reads like an echo of one source is pooled, sharing a single reward. An honest agent writing its own work earns in full. A sybil farm feeding many shells from one model and one prompt produces near-twins that land in the same pool, so a thousand fakes earn like one. To escape, the attacker must pay for truly distinct reasoning per identity, a separate inlet of compute and thought for each, until the crystal-clear profit of cheap clones is gone.
